description:
Rotarian Kasamali Merchant recently visited the Rotary Club of London. • It is the premier Rotary Club in Britain and the first Rotary Club to be chartered outside North America. • Founded in 1911, it is among the oldest Rotary Clubs in the world and one of only four Clubs in Britain and
Ireland established that year.
